senses.en: Making someone feel afraid.

ex.en: The sudden thunder was frightening, but our dog stayed calm.
Experiencing a major flood can be frightening, especially for children who have never faced a natural disaster.

col: frightening prospect｜viễn cảnh đáng lo ngại
tip: frightening mô tả điều gây sợ; frightened mô tả người cảm thấy sợ.

senses.zh: đường mòn; đường chạy; đường ray
senses.en: A path or course for walking, running, or trains.
To follow movement or monitor changes over time.
A mark left by a person, animal, or vehicle.

ex.en: We followed a narrow track through the pine forest.
Researchers use satellite technology to track animal movements and identify habitats that require greater protection.

col: a railway track｜đường ray tàu hỏa
keep track of｜luôn nắm được; ghi chép lại
tip: keep track of nghĩa là liên tục nắm được thông tin; lose track of nghĩa là mất dấu.

senses.en: In, from, or relating to the north.

ex.en: My grandparents live in a quiet northern village.
Northern regions often face higher heating costs, making energy efficiency particularly important for local households.

col: northern regions｜các khu vực phía bắc
the northern coast｜bờ biển phía bắc
tip: northern là tính từ, thường đứng trước danh từ như region, coast.

senses.en: except if; if something does not happen or is untrue

ex.en: We will eat outside unless it starts to rain.
Public transport will remain unpopular unless local authorities improve its reliability and make fares more affordable.

col: unless otherwise stated｜trừ khi có quy định khác
unless absolutely necessary｜trừ khi thật sự cần thiết
unless circumstances change｜trừ khi hoàn cảnh thay đổi
tip: Với điều kiện ở tương lai, mệnh đề unless thường dùng thì hiện tại đơn.

senses.en: Worth a lot of money or deserving great care.
Deeply valued because of personal importance or limited availability.

ex.en: She keeps her precious necklace in a velvet box.
Fresh water is a precious resource that requires careful management as populations grow and temperatures rise.

col: precious memories｜những kỷ niệm quý giá
tip: Có thể chỉ giá trị tiền bạc cao, cũng có thể là quý vì tình cảm hoặc vì khan hiếm.

senses.en: To make, grow, or create something.
To cause a result or effect.
Food grown on farms, especially fruit and vegetables.

ex.en: Our garden produces enough tomatoes for the whole family.
Investing in renewable energy can produce long-term benefits for both local communities and the environment.

tip: Động từ nhấn trọng âm ở sau, danh từ nhấn ở trước; nghĩa nông sản không đếm được.

senses.zh: thuộc kinh tế; liên quan đến kinh tế học
senses.en: Relating to trade, industry, money, or the study of these.

ex.en: The news discussed economic problems affecting local shops.
Investment in public transport can support economic growth by connecting workers with a wider range of jobs.

tip: economic nghĩa là về kinh tế; economical nghĩa là tiết kiệm.

senses.en: material burned or used to produce heat or power
to supply something with fuel

senses.zh: làm trầm trọng thêm; thúc đẩy
senses.en: to make a feeling or situation stronger

ex.en: We stopped for fuel before driving into the mountains.
Growing demand for private cars may fuel air pollution unless governments promote cleaner alternatives.

col: fuel consumption｜mức tiêu thụ nhiên liệu
fuel speculation｜thổi bùng sự suy đoán
tip: fuel làm động từ còn có nghĩa thổi bùng cảm xúc hoặc thúc đẩy sự thay đổi.

senses.en: A thick, soft mixture, sometimes used for sticking things together.
To stick something onto a surface using paste.
To insert copied text or images into a digital location.

ex.en: Mix the flour with water to make a paste.
Students should not simply paste material from websites into assignments without acknowledging the original sources.

col: copy and paste｜sao chép và dán
tip: Nghĩa hỗn hợp sệt thường không đếm được; trong máy tính nghĩa là “dán”.

senses.en: relating to money or how it is managed

ex.en: We asked for financial advice before buying our first home.
Financial support for disadvantaged students can improve access to higher education and reduce long-term inequality.

col: financial stability｜sự ổn định tài chính
tip: financial thiên về tiền bạc và tài chính; economic thiên về nền kinh tế nói chung.

senses.en: The part of your face below your mouth.

ex.en: He rested his chin on his hand and sighed.
Cyclists should adjust helmet straps beneath the chin to ensure a secure fit during travel.

col: rest your chin on your hand｜chống cằm lên tay
tip: chin là cằm; jaw là hàm, phạm vi rộng hơn.

senses.en: To some extent, but not completely.

ex.en: The path was partly covered with fallen leaves.
The rise in cycling is partly due to improved infrastructure and growing concern about air quality.

col: partly responsible｜chịu một phần trách nhiệm
tip: Chỉ một phần chứ không phải toàn bộ; thường dùng partly because để nêu lý do.

senses.en: considering only the main facts or most important features

ex.en: The two recipes are basically the same, except for spices.
Although delivery methods have changed, the purpose of public education remains basically the same across generations.

col: basically the same｜về cơ bản là giống nhau
basically sound｜về cơ bản là hợp lý
basically means｜về cơ bản có nghĩa là
tip: Dùng để tóm lược tình hình cốt lõi; không có nghĩa là “hầu như không” như barely.

senses.en: Containing a substance that can cause illness or death.
Extremely unkind or harmful to relationships.

ex.en: Some colourful berries are poisonous, so leave them alone.
Factories must prevent poisonous substances from entering rivers that supply drinking water to nearby communities.

col: poisonous remarks｜những lời lẽ độc địa
tip: poisonous là có độc; venomous nhấn mạnh việc cắn hoặc đốt tiêm nọc độc.

senses.en: Belonging to a style that was common in the past.
Following beliefs or customs associated with earlier times.

ex.en: My grandfather still uses an old-fashioned clock with a pendulum.
Although some teaching methods seem old-fashioned, they can still help students develop concentration and independent thinking.

col: old-fashioned values｜những giá trị truyền thống
tip: Có thể mang nghĩa hoài niệm, đáng quý; outdated nhấn mạnh là đã không còn phù hợp.

senses.en: A sweet-smelling substance from tropical plant pods, used to flavour food.
Flavoured with vanilla.

ex.en: Add a little vanilla before you mix the batter.
Demand for natural vanilla can provide valuable income for farmers, but unstable prices create financial risks.

tip: vanilla trong thực phẩm chỉ một loại hương liệu cụ thể.

senses.en: made from waste materials processed for use again

ex.en: This notebook is made entirely from recycled paper.
Using recycled materials in construction can reduce demand for natural resources and limit waste sent to landfill.

tip: recycled là đã được tái chế; recyclable là có thể tái chế.

senses.en: Information that helps you solve a problem or understand something.

ex.en: The muddy footprints gave us a clue about the visitor.
Ancient tools provide valuable clues about how early communities adapted to changes in their natural environment.

col: not have a clue｜hoàn toàn không biết
tip: to trong a clue to là giới từ, theo sau là danh từ.

senses.en: A coin worth ten cents in the US or Canada.

ex.en: A shiny dime rolled out of my jacket pocket.
Although a dime has little purchasing power, small cash donations can collectively support valuable community projects.

col: a dime a dozen｜rẻ mạt; nhiều vô kể
not cost a dime｜không tốn một xu
on a dime｜đột ngột; trong phạm vi rất nhỏ
tip: Một đô la bằng mười dime; chủ yếu dùng trong bối cảnh Mỹ và Canada.

senses.en: what is real or actually happened
a fact or principle generally accepted as true

ex.en: Please tell me the truth about the broken cup.
Journalists should seek the truth rather than publish stories that simply attract public attention.

col: discover the truth｜khám phá sự thật
the truth about something｜sự thật về điều gì
tip: Nói thật dùng tell the truth, thường không bỏ the.

senses.en: a structure that sends water into the air
a device supplying a stream of water for drinking

ex.en: Children watched the fountain sparkle in the afternoon sunlight.
A fountain can make a public square more attractive, although its maintenance requires water and energy.

col: drinking fountain｜vòi nước uống công cộng
ornamental fountain｜đài phun nước trang trí
tip: drinking fountain là vòi nước uống công cộng; fountain pen là bút máy.

senses.en: someone who attacks ships and steals from them
to copy or distribute protected material without permission
someone who illegally copies or distributes protected material

ex.en: The pirate in the story sailed a wooden ship.
When companies pirate educational software, they undermine the income that developers need to improve their products.

tip: pirated nhấn mạnh bị sao chép trái phép; piracy là danh từ tương ứng.

senses.en: having little or no hair on the head
lacking the usual covering or surface texture

ex.en: My uncle is bald and always wears a hat.
Driving with bald tyres increases the risk of accidents, particularly when roads are wet or icy.

tip: bald là hói; bold là táo bạo, cần chú ý chính tả và cách phát âm.

senses.en: only, with nothing more involved

senses.zh: một cách đơn giản; giản dị
senses.en: in an uncomplicated or plain way
used to emphasise how strongly something is true

ex.en: I simply want a quiet evening at home.
Improving public health requires more than simply encouraging individuals to exercise; affordable facilities are also essential.

col: put simply｜nói một cách đơn giản
simply impossible｜đơn giản là không thể
tip: simply có thể nghĩa là “chỉ là”, không nhất thiết là “đơn giản”.

senses.en: Clearly decided or known, without uncertainty.
Clearly noticeable or unquestionably present.

ex.en: We need a definite answer before booking the tickets.
Reliable public transport offers definite advantages for cities seeking to reduce congestion and improve air quality.

col: a definite answer｜câu trả lời dứt khoát
a definite advantage｜lợi thế rõ rệt
tip: definite là tính từ; definitely là trạng từ, nghĩa là chắc chắn.

senses.en: Kind and careful, without roughness or force.
Mild in strength, movement, or effect.
Rising or falling gradually rather than steeply.

ex.en: Be gentle when you pick up the little kitten.
Gentle exercise, such as walking or swimming, can improve physical health without placing excessive strain on joints.

col: a gentle touch｜cái chạm nhẹ nhàng
tip: Dịu dàng với ai dùng be gentle with sb.

senses.en: a performer who entertains people by making them laugh

ex.en: The comedian made everyone laugh with stories about his cat.
A skilled comedian can encourage audiences to question social habits while providing enjoyable entertainment.

col: stand-up comedian｜diễn viên hài độc thoại
professional comedian｜diễn viên hài chuyên nghiệp
talented comedian｜diễn viên hài tài năng
tip: comedian chỉ người; comedy chỉ thể loại hài hoặc tác phẩm hài.

senses.zh: thành tích; hiệu suất; hiệu năng
senses.en: How well a person, organisation or machine does something.
An occasion when someone entertains an audience by performing.

senses.zh: sự thực hiện; sự thi hành
senses.en: The act of carrying out a task or duty.

ex.en: The coach praised our performance after the football match.
Regular feedback can improve employee performance by helping workers understand expectations and address specific weaknesses.

col: live performance｜buổi biểu diễn trực tiếp
performance of duties｜việc thực hiện nhiệm vụ
tip: Kết quả hoạt động nói chung thường không đếm được; một buổi diễn thì dùng a performance.

senses.zh: ký túc xá; phòng ngủ tập thể
senses.en: a building or shared room where students sleep

ex.en: My dorm is just five minutes from the library.
Living in a dorm can help first-year students develop social skills and adjust to university life.

col: dorm life｜cuộc sống ký túc xá
college dorm｜ký túc xá đại học
tip: dorm là cách nói tắt không trang trọng của dormitory, thường gặp trong Anh-Mỹ.

senses.en: a general direction of change or development
to become widely discussed or shared online

ex.en: Growing vegetables at home is a popular trend here.
The growing trend towards remote working may reduce traffic congestion in major cities.

col: an upward trend｜xu hướng đi lên
a growing trend｜xu hướng ngày càng rõ
follow a trend｜chạy theo xu hướng
a trend towards｜xu hướng hướng tới
tip: Xu hướng hướng tới điều gì thường dùng a trend towards + danh từ.

senses.en: Low land between hills or mountains, often containing a river.

ex.en: A narrow river winds through the green valley.
Farming communities in the valley depend on seasonal rainfall to maintain their crops and support local livelihoods.

tip: valley là vùng đất thấp giữa các dãy núi, không phải là bồn địa (basin).

senses.en: to make someone believe something is true
to persuade someone to do something

ex.en: The photos convinced me that the flat was spacious.
Governments must convince residents that improved public transport offers a practical alternative to private cars.

col: convince someone of something｜làm ai tin điều gì
convince someone that｜làm ai tin rằng
convince someone to do something｜thuyết phục ai làm gì
tip: convince sb of sth nghĩa là làm ai tin điều gì.

senses.en: A passage inside a building or space by its entrance

ex.en: Please leave your muddy boots in the hallway.
Wide hallways and accessible entrances make public buildings easier to navigate for people with limited mobility.

tip: Có thể chỉ sảnh vào nhà hoặc hành lang nối các phòng.

senses.en: to join or repair fabric using a needle and thread

ex.en: Can you sew this button back onto my coat?
Learning to sew enables people to repair damaged clothes rather than discard them, reducing household waste.

col: sew on a button｜khâu nút áo
sew up a hole｜vá lỗ thủng
tip: Quá khứ là sewed; phân từ quá khứ là sewn hoặc sewed; phát âm giống so.

senses.en: To make something smaller or less in amount or degree.

ex.en: We can reduce waste by using our leftovers.
Governments should invest in renewable energy to reduce carbon emissions and improve long-term energy security.

tip: reduce by theo sau là mức giảm; reduce to theo sau là mức sau khi giảm.

senses.en: a publication containing articles about a particular subject
a personal record of experiences, thoughts, or events

ex.en: I keep a journal beside my bed every night.
Researchers publish their findings in academic journals so that other experts can evaluate the evidence.

col: an academic journal｜tạp chí học thuật
a medical journal｜tạp chí y học
a journal article｜bài báo trên tạp chí
tip: journal thường là tạp chí chuyên ngành; khi chỉ ghi chép cá nhân thì gần với diary.

senses.en: getting someone to act or believe something by giving reasons

ex.en: She is persuading her brother to try vegetable soup.
Persuading commuters to use public transport requires reliable services as well as affordable fares and convenient routes.

col: persuading someone to act｜thuyết phục ai hành động
persuading someone of the benefits｜thuyết phục ai về lợi ích
persuading someone that｜thuyết phục ai rằng
tip: Dạng -ing của persuade; thuyết phục ai làm gì dùng to do.

senses.en: full of energy, activity, or excitement
interesting and engaging, with enthusiastic activity or discussion

ex.en: The lively puppy chased a ball around the garden.
Lively classroom discussions can encourage students to consider different perspectives and develop critical thinking skills.

col: lively debate｜cuộc tranh luận sôi nổi
lively atmosphere｜bầu không khí náo nhiệt
lively imagination｜trí tưởng tượng phong phú
tip: Dù kết thúc bằng -ly, lively vẫn là tính từ, không phải trạng từ.

senses.en: an artwork made by carving, shaping, or assembling materials
the art of creating solid forms from materials

ex.en: A bronze sculpture of a horse stands outside the library.
Public sculpture can strengthen a city's cultural identity while making art accessible to people outside traditional galleries.

col: a bronze sculpture｜tác phẩm điêu khắc bằng đồng
abstract sculpture｜tác phẩm điêu khắc trừu tượng
tip: Chỉ bộ môn nghệ thuật thì không đếm được; chỉ một tác phẩm thì đếm được.

senses.en: the desire or need for particular goods or services
a strong request that someone expects to be obeyed
to insist on receiving something or require something essential

ex.en: Demand for cold drinks rises sharply during hot weather.
Growing demand for affordable housing has encouraged local authorities to convert unused office buildings into residential accommodation.

col: demand for housing｜nhu cầu nhà ở
in high demand｜có nhu cầu cao
demand an explanation｜đòi hỏi một lời giải thích
tip: Đòi hỏi làm gì dùng demand to do, không dùng demand sb to do.

senses.en: relating to formal Western music, such as symphonies and operas

senses.zh: thuộc Hy Lạp La Mã cổ đại; cổ điển
senses.en: relating to ancient Greece or Rome and their culture

senses.zh: thuộc lý thuyết truyền thống; cổ điển
senses.en: based on established theories rather than newer approaches

ex.en: My sister listens to classical music while cooking.
Studying classical architecture helps students understand how ancient design principles continue to influence modern public buildings.

col: classical civilisation｜nền văn minh cổ điển
tip: Nhạc cổ điển dùng classical; tác phẩm kinh điển thường dùng classic.

senses.en: A hard black or brown material burned to produce heat.

ex.en: The old stove still burns coal during winter.
Replacing coal with renewable energy can reduce air pollution and lower greenhouse gas emissions from electricity generation.

col: coal-fired power station｜nhà máy nhiệt điện than
tip: coal là than đá, charcoal là than củi; coal thường dùng như danh từ không đếm được.

senses.en: to accept that something is true, often reluctantly
to allow someone to enter or join a place or institution

ex.en: I admit that I forgot to water your plants.
Governments should admit when policies have failed and use reliable evidence to develop more effective alternatives.

col: admit a mistake｜thừa nhận sai lầm
admit doing something｜thừa nhận đã làm gì
be admitted to hospital｜được nhận vào bệnh viện
tip: Dùng admit doing, không dùng admit to do; quá khứ gấp đôi chữ t.

senses.zh: đồ vật bên trong; nội dung bên trong
senses.en: the things held inside a container or space
a list of a publication's sections and their locations

ex.en: She emptied the contents of her bag onto the table.
A detailed table of contents helps readers locate relevant information quickly in lengthy academic reports.

col: contents of a bag｜đồ vật trong túi
tip: contents nghĩa là đồ vật bên trong hoặc mục lục; nội dung bài viết thường dùng content.

senses.en: tidy and carefully arranged
clever, simple, and effective

ex.en: She keeps her gardening tools in neat rows.
Keeping shared workspaces neat can improve efficiency by making essential equipment easier to locate.

col: neat and tidy｜sạch sẽ gọn gàng
a neat solution｜một giải pháp khéo léo
tip: Ngoài nghĩa gọn gàng, neat còn dùng để khen cách giải quyết khéo léo, ngắn gọn.

senses.en: to share information, thoughts, or feelings with others
to make information or feelings known to someone

ex.en: We communicate with our neighbours through a shared online group.
Teachers need to communicate complex ideas clearly so that students with different abilities can understand them.

tip: Giao tiếp với ai dùng with; truyền đạt điều gì cho ai thì dùng điều đó + to.

senses.en: To make information known publicly or officially.

ex.en: Our teacher announced the winners after lunch today.
Local authorities should announce major policy changes early so residents have enough time to prepare.

col: announce a decision｜công bố quyết định
announce the results｜công bố kết quả
tip: Dùng announce sth hoặc announce that, không dùng announce sb sth.

senses.en: People living together in an organised community.
An organisation for people who share an interest or purpose.

ex.en: Everyone has a part to play in society.
An ageing society requires accessible healthcare and policies that support older people's independence.

col: an ageing society｜xã hội già hóa
society as a whole｜toàn xã hội
join a society｜gia nhập một hội
tip: Chỉ xã hội nói chung thường không dùng the; nghĩa là hội, hiệp hội thì đếm được.

senses.en: a public message promoting a product, service, or opportunity

ex.en: An ad for cooking classes caught my attention yesterday.
Online ads can influence consumer choices by presenting products that match users' browsing habits and interests.

tip: ad là cách viết tắt không trang trọng của advertisement, là danh từ đếm được.

senses.en: taking place or located outside, without a roof

ex.en: We watched a film at an open-air cinema last night.
Open-air markets can attract visitors while providing affordable trading spaces for small local businesses.

col: open-air concert｜buổi hòa nhạc ngoài trời
tip: Khi làm tính từ có gạch nối; in the open air nghĩa là ở ngoài trời.

senses.en: body tissue that tightens and relaxes to produce movement
power or influence used to achieve something

ex.en: I pulled a muscle while lifting a heavy box.
Regular strength training builds muscle and helps older adults maintain balance and independence in daily life.

tip: Chữ c trong muscle không phát âm; pull a muscle nghĩa là bị căng hoặc rách cơ.

senses.en: a noticeable or important part of something
to include or present someone or something prominently
a part of the face, such as the nose

ex.en: My favourite feature of this backpack is its hidden pocket.
Public parks are an essential feature of cities that prioritise residents' health and wellbeing.

col: facial features｜các nét trên khuôn mặt
feature prominently｜đóng vai trò nổi bật
tip: Khi là động từ, feature đi thẳng với tân ngữ, không nói feature with.

senses.en: for a particular purpose or person

ex.en: I made this cushion specially for your chair.
Schools should provide specially designed learning materials to support students with different educational needs.

col: specially trained｜được đào tạo chuyên biệt
specially made｜làm riêng; chế tạo đặc biệt
tip: specially nhấn mạnh mục đích riêng; especially nhấn mạnh “đặc biệt là”.

senses.en: An intelligent aquatic mammal with a long snout and curved fin.

ex.en: A dolphin leapt beside our boat early this morning.
Underwater noise from shipping can disrupt dolphin communication and make it harder for these animals to find food.

col: a pod of dolphins｜một đàn cá heo
tip: Cá heo là động vật có vú; một đàn cá heo có thể nói a pod of dolphins.

senses.zh: người giúp việc nữ; nữ nhân viên dọn phòng
senses.en: a woman employed to clean rooms or do household work

ex.en: The hotel maid brought fresh towels to our room.
Hotels should provide every maid with suitable equipment and sufficient time to clean rooms safely.

col: hotel maid｜nữ nhân viên dọn phòng khách sạn
work as a maid｜làm người giúp việc
tip: Chỉ nữ nhân viên làm việc nhà hoặc dọn dẹp; trong khách sạn thường dùng room attendant.

senses.en: To say you are sorry for something you have done.

ex.en: I should apologise for spilling juice on your jacket.
Companies should apologise publicly when their mistakes cause inconvenience or financial loss to customers.

col: apologise for something｜xin lỗi vì điều gì
tip: Cách viết Anh-Anh; Anh-Mỹ thường dùng apologize, theo sau là to + người, for + việc.

senses.en: the state of being ill
the feeling of needing to vomit, or vomiting itself

ex.en: Several children missed school because of sickness this week.
Employers can reduce absence due to sickness by improving ventilation and encouraging staff to stay home when unwell.

tip: Thường không đếm được; trong Anh-Anh cũng hay chỉ buồn nôn hoặc nôn.

senses.en: an object that burns or explodes with bright colours outdoors

ex.en: A single firework burst above the lake, scattering golden sparks.
Public firework displays can attract visitors, although their noise may disturb local residents and wildlife.

tip: Một quả pháo hoa thì đếm được; nói chung hoặc chỉ màn trình diễn thì thường dùng fireworks.

senses.zh: chính trị; hoạt động chính trị
senses.en: activities concerning government and how a country is run
a person's beliefs about government and public affairs

ex.en: My uncle loves discussing politics over dinner with friends.
Greater involvement in politics can help young people influence decisions that affect their future.

tip: Khi chỉ hoạt động chính trị thường đi với động từ số ít; quan điểm chính trị có thể đi với số nhiều.

senses.en: Someone who gathers and reports news for the media.

ex.en: The journalist interviewed our neighbour about the new park.
A responsible journalist should verify information carefully before publishing stories that could influence public opinion.

col: broadcast journalist｜nhà báo truyền hình, phát thanh
tip: journalist chỉ chung người làm báo, reporter thiên về người đi lấy tin.

senses.en: tell someone about possible danger or an unpleasant consequence

ex.en: Please warn me if the pan gets too hot.
Scientists warn that continued habitat loss could put many more species at risk of extinction.

col: warn someone about something｜cảnh báo ai về điều gì
warn against doing something｜cảnh báo không nên làm gì
warn someone not to do something｜cảnh báo ai đừng làm gì
tip: warn có thể theo sau là mệnh đề that; warn sb not to do dùng để răn đe, dặn dò.

senses.en: Rub a surface to remove dirt, liquid, or marks.
An act of rubbing a surface to clean or dry it.
A small damp cloth used for cleaning, usually thrown away afterwards.

ex.en: Please wipe the table before you put the plates down.
Schools should encourage pupils to wipe shared equipment after use to help maintain a hygienic learning environment.

col: wipe a surface｜lau một bề mặt
give something a wipe｜lau qua một cái
tip: wipe nhấn mạnh việc lau; wipe out có thể nghĩa là xóa sạch hoàn toàn.

senses.en: Someone whose job is to prepare and check financial records

ex.en: The accountant checked our expenses before we opened the café.
Employing a qualified accountant helps small businesses manage taxes accurately and make better financial decisions.

col: qualified accountant｜kế toán có chứng chỉ
hire an accountant｜thuê một kế toán
tip: accountant chỉ người; accounting chỉ công việc hoặc ngành kế toán.

senses.zh: sự so sánh; sự đối chiếu
senses.en: Examining things to see how they are similar or different.

ex.en: A quick comparison helped me choose the cheaper bicycle.
A comparison of public transport systems reveals significant differences in cost, reliability and environmental impact.

col: a direct comparison｜so sánh trực tiếp
tip: So sánh giữa hai đối tượng dùng comparison between A and B.

senses.en: A substance produced or used in a chemical process.
Relating to substances and how they combine or change.

ex.en: Keep cleaning chemicals safely out of children's reach.
Farmers can protect nearby rivers by reducing the amount of agricultural chemicals used on their land.

col: a chemical reaction｜phản ứng hóa học
the chemical industry｜ngành công nghiệp hóa chất
tip: Danh từ chemical đếm được; hóa chất không nhất thiết có hại.

senses.en: The extent or variety of things within certain limits.
To vary between particular limits.
A connected group of mountains.

ex.en: This shop sells a wide range of fresh fruit.
Universities should offer a broader range of courses to meet the changing needs of employers.

col: a wide range of｜rất nhiều loại
range from A to B｜dao động từ A đến B
tip: range from A to B nghĩa là dao động từ A đến B; dãy núi thì dùng danh từ.

senses.zh: điều bí ẩn; điều khó giải thích
senses.en: Something that is unknown or cannot be explained

senses.zh: vẻ bí ẩn; tính huyền bí
senses.en: The quality of being strange, secret, or difficult to understand

senses.zh: truyện trinh thám; truyện bí ẩn
senses.en: A story about solving a puzzling event, often a crime

ex.en: Who left these flowers outside remains a mystery.
Despite advances in marine research, the behaviour of many deep ocean species remains a mystery.

col: solve a mystery｜giải một bí ẩn
remain a mystery｜vẫn còn là bí ẩn
a sense of mystery｜cảm giác bí ẩn
tip: Một điều bí ẩn dùng a mystery; vẻ bí ẩn thường không đếm được.

senses.zh: nhân viên đánh máy; người đánh máy
senses.en: A person who types, especially as a job.

ex.en: The typist finished the letter before her lunch break.
Although dedicated typist positions are less common today, accurate keyboard skills remain valuable in many workplaces.

col: a fast typist｜người đánh máy nhanh
a skilled typist｜nhân viên đánh máy lành nghề
a touch typist｜người đánh máy bằng mười ngón
tip: typist chỉ người; typing chỉ hoạt động đánh máy, typewriter là máy đánh chữ.

senses.zh: sách hướng dẫn du lịch; sách hướng dẫn
senses.en: a book giving information about a place or practical subject

ex.en: Our guidebook recommended a quiet beach near the village.
Although digital maps are convenient, a detailed guidebook can provide valuable cultural context for independent travellers.

col: a travel guidebook｜sách hướng dẫn du lịch
a guidebook to｜sách hướng dẫn về
consult a guidebook｜tham khảo sách hướng dẫn
tip: Sách hướng dẫn về một nơi thường dùng a guidebook to + địa điểm.

senses.en: A vegetable with dark green leaves eaten raw or cooked.

ex.en: I added fresh spinach to the soup before dinner.
Leafy vegetables such as spinach provide nutrients that support a healthy, balanced diet.

tip: Thường không đếm được; một lá rau chân vịt nói a spinach leaf.

senses.zh: sự thoải mái; sự dễ chịu
senses.en: A pleasant state of physical ease and relaxation.

senses.zh: sự an ủi; niềm an ủi
senses.en: Relief from sadness or worry, or something providing it.
To help someone feel less sad, worried, or upset.

ex.en: I enjoyed the comfort of a warm bed after camping.
Support groups can comfort patients by providing opportunities to share experiences and discuss concerns openly.

col: take comfort in｜tìm thấy niềm an ủi trong
creature comforts｜những tiện nghi vật chất
tip: Nghĩa thoải mái hoặc an ủi thường không đếm được; làm động từ đi thẳng với người.

senses.en: Having an allergy to a particular substance
Caused by an allergy

ex.en: I am allergic to cats, so I keep my distance.
Restaurants should provide accurate ingredient information to protect customers who are allergic to common foods.

col: allergic to pollen｜dị ứng phấn hoa
tip: Dị ứng với cái gì dùng be allergic to, không dùng allergic with.

senses.zh: mối liên hệ; sự kết nối
senses.en: a connection between people, things, or ideas
a clickable element that opens another webpage or digital resource
to connect things or show a relationship between them

ex.en: The new bridge provides a link between the villages.
Researchers have identified a strong link between regular physical activity and improved mental health.

col: a link between｜mối liên hệ giữa
click a link｜nhấp vào liên kết
link A to B｜liên kết A với B
transport links｜các tuyến giao thông kết nối
tip: Thường dùng a link between A and B; động từ dùng link A to/with B.

senses.en: the particular taste of food or drink

senses.zh: nêm gia vị; tạo hương vị
senses.en: to give food or drink a particular taste
a distinctive quality that gives something its character

ex.en: Fresh basil gives this soup a lovely flavour.
School cooking lessons can teach children how to improve flavour without adding excessive salt or sugar.

col: flavour with herbs｜nêm bằng thảo mộc
tip: Anh-Anh viết flavour, Anh-Mỹ viết flavor.

senses.en: A large waterbird with a long neck and webbed feet.
Meat from a goose, eaten as food.

ex.en: A white goose waddled across the path towards us.
Protecting wetlands provides essential feeding grounds for wild geese and many other migratory birds.

col: a flock of geese｜một đàn ngỗng
tip: Số nhiều là geese; thịt ngỗng thì không đếm được.

senses.en: Relaxed and friendly rather than following strict social rules.
Suitable for casual communication rather than formal writing or speech.

senses.zh: không chính thức; không chính quy
senses.en: Not officially arranged, recognized, or controlled.

ex.en: We had an informal chat over tea this morning.
Informal learning outside the classroom allows children to develop practical skills through play and everyday experiences.

col: informal language｜ngôn ngữ không trang trọng
informal learning｜học tập không chính quy
tip: Không câu nệ lễ nghi, không có nghĩa là bất lịch sự hay thiếu chuyên nghiệp.

senses.en: a fish with pink flesh, or its flesh as food
having a pink colour with a slight orange shade

ex.en: We watched a salmon leap up the rocky stream.
Dams can disrupt salmon migration, so river management should consider both energy production and wildlife protection.

tip: Chữ l không phát âm; khi chỉ con cá thì số ít và số nhiều giống nhau, chỉ thịt cá thì không đếm được.

senses.en: A large bird often raised for its meat
Meat from a turkey, eaten as food
Something that fails badly, especially a film or play

ex.en: A turkey spread its tail feathers near the farm gate.
Turkey production provides affordable protein, but intensive farming can raise concerns about animal welfare and environmental damage.

tip: Con gà tây đếm được, thịt gà tây không đếm được; nghĩa “tác phẩm thất bại” là cách dùng không trang trọng.

senses.en: sound recorded on magnetic tape

ex.en: We found a tape-recording of our grandfather singing.
A tape-recording of a traditional song can help researchers understand how local musical styles have changed.

col: make a tape-recording｜thực hiện bản ghi âm băng từ
listen to a tape-recording｜nghe bản ghi âm băng từ
a tape-recording of an interview｜bản ghi âm băng từ cuộc phỏng vấn
tip: Cũng thường viết là tape recording; ghi âm kỹ thuật số thường dùng recording.

senses.en: Not known, identified, or familiar.

senses.zh: điều chưa biết; người vô danh
senses.en: Something not yet understood, or a person not widely known.

ex.en: An unknown caller rang while I was cooking dinner.
The long-term effects of some new materials remain unknown, so further research is essential before widespread use.

col: unknown to someone｜ai đó không biết
an unknown cause｜nguyên nhân chưa rõ
tip: the unknown chỉ những điều hoặc lĩnh vực chưa biết.

senses.en: a pronunciation style associated with a place or social group
emphasis on a syllable, or a mark indicating pronunciation
to give special emphasis or prominence to something

ex.en: Her accent reminds me of my neighbours back home.
Teachers should value different accents while helping learners develop clear pronunciation for effective international communication.

col: speak with an accent｜nói có giọng
tip: accent nói về cách phát âm; dialect còn liên quan đến từ vựng và ngữ pháp.

senses.en: A structure whose wind-driven sails power machinery, often for grinding grain.

ex.en: We watched the old windmill turn beside the river.
Restoring a traditional windmill can preserve local heritage while attracting visitors interested in the history of rural technology.

col: a traditional windmill｜một cối xay gió truyền thống
restore a windmill｜phục hồi cối xay gió
windmill sails｜cánh quạt cối xay gió
tip: Tuabin gió phát điện hiện đại thường gọi là wind turbine.

senses.en: an amount expressed as a fraction of one hundred

ex.en: What percentage of your monthly income goes on rent?
The percentage of households using renewable energy has increased as installation costs have fallen in recent years.

col: a high percentage of｜tỷ lệ cao của
a small percentage of｜một tỷ lệ nhỏ của
percentage increase｜mức tăng theo phần trăm
tip: Sau con số dùng percent; nói về tỷ lệ thì dùng percentage.

senses.en: Responsible for breaking a law or doing something wrong.

senses.zh: cảm thấy tội lỗi; áy náy
senses.en: Feeling bad because you believe you have done something wrong.

ex.en: I felt guilty about forgetting my sister's birthday.
Companies found guilty of illegally dumping waste should face penalties that reflect the environmental damage caused.

col: find someone guilty｜tuyên ai có tội
feel guilty about｜cảm thấy tội lỗi về
tip: guilty of + tội danh; feel guilty about + việc khiến mình áy náy.

senses.en: to send goods to another country for sale

senses.zh: hàng xuất khẩu; việc xuất khẩu
senses.en: selling goods abroad, or goods sold to another country
to save computer data in a format another program uses

ex.en: My aunt's company exports handmade bowls to several countries.
Countries that export mainly raw materials may be vulnerable to sudden changes in global commodity prices.

col: export earnings｜thu nhập từ xuất khẩu
tip: Động từ nhấn trọng âm ở sau; danh từ nhấn trọng âm ở trước.

senses.zh: bể cá; bể nuôi thủy sinh
senses.en: A water-filled container for keeping fish and other aquatic animals
A public building where people can see aquatic animals

ex.en: Two orange fish swim among plants in our aquarium.
A well-managed aquarium can teach visitors about marine ecosystems and encourage greater concern for ocean conservation.

col: a freshwater aquarium｜bể cá nước ngọt
a public aquarium｜thủy cung công cộng
tip: Vừa chỉ bể cá trong nhà, vừa chỉ thủy cung cho công chúng tham quan.

senses.en: A person or organisation trying to succeed against others.

senses.zh: thí sinh; vận động viên tham dự
senses.en: Someone taking part in a competition.

ex.en: The new bakery is our biggest competitor for local customers.
A business must understand its competitors before developing strategies to attract customers in an increasingly crowded market.

col: a major competitor｜đối thủ cạnh tranh chính
a direct competitor｜đối thủ trực tiếp
tip: competitor chỉ người cạnh tranh; competition chỉ sự cạnh tranh hoặc cuộc thi.

senses.en: take air into your lungs and let it out

ex.en: Sit by the window and breathe slowly for a minute.
People living near busy roads often breathe polluted air, which can increase their risk of respiratory illness.

col: breathe fresh air｜hít thở không khí trong lành
tip: breathe là động từ, âm cuối /ð/; breath là danh từ, âm cuối /θ/.

senses.en: To say what will happen, often using evidence.

ex.en: They predict heavy rain, so take your umbrella.
Climate models help scientists predict how rising temperatures may affect agricultural production in different regions.

col: predict the outcome｜dự đoán kết quả
tip: Có thể theo sau là mệnh đề that; đừng nhầm với prevent (ngăn ngừa).

senses.en: Someone whose job is repairing vehicles or machines.

ex.en: The mechanic found a leak under our car.
As electric vehicles become more common, mechanics need additional training to maintain their complex systems safely.

col: a qualified mechanic｜thợ máy có tay nghề
work as a mechanic｜làm thợ máy
tip: mechanic là thợ sửa chữa; mechanics có thể chỉ môn cơ học.

senses.en: to keep someone interested or amused
to welcome guests and provide food, drink, or activities
to consider an idea or hold a thought or feeling

ex.en: My brother entertained the children with funny animal noises.
Public museums should educate visitors as well as entertain them through engaging displays and interactive activities.

col: entertain an audience｜làm khán giả giải trí
entertain the idea of｜cân nhắc ý tưởng về
tip: entertain an idea nghĩa là cân nhắc một ý tưởng, chưa chắc đã chấp nhận.

senses.en: drinks containing a substance that can make people drunk
a colourless liquid used in drinks, cleaning products, and fuels

ex.en: This restaurant serves fresh juice but does not sell alcohol.
Public health campaigns should explain how excessive alcohol consumption can damage both physical and mental health.

tip: Nói chung về rượu hoặc cồn thường không đếm được; a drink có thể chỉ một ly rượu.

senses.en: A room or floor below ground level in a building.

ex.en: We keep our bicycles in the basement during winter.
Converting unused basement space into community facilities can help densely populated neighbourhoods accommodate more activities.

col: in the basement｜ở dưới tầng hầm
basement storage｜kho chứa ở tầng hầm
tip: basement có thể dùng để ở; cellar thường chỉ hầm chứa đồ.

senses.en: To suddenly force air out through your nose and mouth.
A sudden, involuntary burst of air from the nose and mouth.

ex.en: Dust from the old rug made me sneeze.
Covering your mouth and nose when you sneeze helps reduce the spread of respiratory infections.

col: sneeze into a tissue｜hắt hơi vào khăn giấy
a fit of sneezing｜một tràng hắt hơi
stifle a sneeze｜nén cái hắt hơi
tip: Động từ nội động từ; “hắt hơi một cái” có thể nói give a sneeze.

senses.en: medical care given to improve an illness or injury

senses.zh: sự đối xử; cách đối đãi
senses.en: the way someone behaves towards a person or group

senses.zh: sự xử lý; sự gia công
senses.en: a process that cleans, protects, or changes a substance

ex.en: After treatment, her injured ankle felt much better.
Access to affordable medical treatment is essential for reducing health inequalities between wealthy and disadvantaged communities.

tip: Điều trị nói chung thường không đếm được; một liệu pháp cụ thể có thể dùng a treatment.

senses.en: Requiring customers to serve themselves rather than wait for staff
A system in which customers serve themselves

ex.en: We carried our trays through the self-service cafeteria.
Although self-service machines can shorten queues, businesses should retain staff to assist customers who need additional support.

col: self-service checkout｜quầy thanh toán tự động
self-service cafeteria｜căng tin tự phục vụ
tip: self-service nhấn mạnh khách tự thao tác, không có nghĩa là máy hoàn toàn tự động.

senses.en: Telling the truth and not cheating or stealing.
Expressing what you really think or feel.

ex.en: The honest cashier returned the money I had overpaid.
Honest communication between teachers and parents can help schools address students' difficulties before they become serious.

col: an honest person｜một người trung thực
an honest answer｜một câu trả lời thẳng thắn
tip: Chữ h không phát âm, nên nói an honest person.

senses.en: A powerful farm vehicle used to pull equipment or loads

ex.en: The farmer drove a tractor across the muddy field.
Using a tractor allows farmers to cultivate larger areas with less physical effort and fewer workers.

tip: tractor là máy kéo, truck là xe tải; chú ý phân biệt.

senses.en: to shout loudly, often from excitement, anger, or fear
a loud shout

ex.en: We yelled with excitement when our team finally scored.
Coaches who yell at young athletes may undermine their confidence rather than improve their performance.

col: let out a yell｜bật ra một tiếng hét
tip: yell at thường kèm giận dữ; yell to nhấn mạnh việc hét để người kia nghe.

senses.en: someone harmed by an accident, crime, or unfair treatment

ex.en: Neighbours brought warm blankets to the flood victims.
Governments should provide practical support for victims of online fraud, including free legal advice.

col: victim of crime｜nạn nhân của tội phạm
fall victim to｜trở thành nạn nhân của
tip: Nạn nhân của việc gì dùng victim of.
